senses.gloss:
(1) CISSAMPELOS PAREIRA LINN. (Avk; Bpn, p. 395; Chopra; Dgm,
p. 34-35; Dgv, nr. 15: लघुपाठा; DWH 1, p. 53-54; Dy, p. 29-30;
KB 1, p. 95-98: पाठा, लघुपाठा; Na 1, nr. 15: लघुपाठा; Nadk.
1, nr. 592: लघुपाठा; V 2, p. 134) = C. HERNANDIFOLIA WALL. [=
C. CAAPEBA ROXB.] (KB 1, p. 95-98) = C. CAAPEBA LINN. [= C.
TRIANDRA ROXB.] (KB 1, p. 95-98) = C. TETRANDRA ROXB. = C.
CONVOLVULACEA WILLD. (KB 1, p. 95-98); unclear are: [C. HERNANDI-
FOLIA LINN.] (Dutt) and C. HERNANDIFOLIA (Avk; Kav; Vśs);
(2) STEPHANIA HERNANDIFOLIA WALP. (Avk; Bpn, p. 395: used as
a substitute; Dgm, p. 34-35; Dutt; HK; Kav; KB 1, p. 92-93; Vśs) =
S. DISCOLOR SPRENG. (DWH 1, p. 54: known by the same native names
as CISSAMPELOS PAREIRA LINN., but it seems that the true name of
this plant is वनतिक्तिका) = CISSAMPELOS HERNANDIFOLIA WILLD. (HK;
KB 1, p. 92-93) = C. HEXANDRA ROXB. (KB 1, p. 92-93; V 6, p. 29;
[]
Wise) = CLYPEA DISCOLOR BLUME = C. HERNANDIFOLIA WIGHT ET
ARN. (HK; KB 1, p. 92-93; MW; PW);
(3) CYCLEA PELTATA HOOK. F. ET THOMS. (Bpn, p. 395: used as a
substitute; Dgv, nr. 15: राजपाठा; Gul; Na 1, nr. 15).
